title: lupinus montanus subsp. montesii
intro: Lupinus montanus subsp. montesii, commonly known as Montes' lupine or Montes' madia, is a plant species in the genus Lupinus, belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). The health benefits of this plant include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus montanus subsp. montesii include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
